doubts: The page is a set of tracks from Post Office Bay (the main wharf), not one walk; W1 is marked main only because one way must be. Post Office Bay has no name or feature entry. The tracks are recorded as out-and-back because the times are 'return to Post Office Bay', but the page says connected paths allow returning by a different route (e.g. Flagstaff Point descending via Sydney Cove). The routes to Boulder Beach and West End Beach (via Sydney Cove and the four-way junction?) are not fully stated, so no via is given. The West End Beach / Boulder Beach loop ('an easy round trip of about three hours') is not recorded as a way because its start and order are not stated.
